title: ἡ κοάλα
learning_goal: Practice present-tense third-person movement with prepositions (εἰσέρχεται, ἐξέρχεται, βαίνει), object handling (ἔχει, φέρει, παίζει, βάλλει), eating and drinking (ἐσθίει, πίνει), and seeking/finding (ζητεῖ, εὑρίσκει), with all nouns marked by articles.
plot: Koala moves from bed to table to eat and drink, goes outside to play and find a ball, returns inside to hide and find an apple, and ends the day in bed.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: The koala is in the bed.
positioning: Koala lies under the green blanket on the small bed at center-left, facing right.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα βαίνει πρὸς τὴν τράπεζαν.
frames.text_english: The koala goes toward the table.
positioning: Koala walks from the left toward the round table at center, looking forward.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ τὸ μῆλον.
frames.text_english: The koala eats the bread and the apple.
objects: A small round loaf of brown bread.
A shiny red apple with a little green leaf.
positioning: Koala sits at the front edge of the round table at center, facing right.
A small round loaf of brown bread sits on the table in front of Koala at center.
A shiny red apple with a little green leaf rests on the table to Koala's right.

objects: A plain brown clay cup filled with water.
positioning: Koala sits at the table at center-left, tilting her head back slightly.
A plain brown clay cup filled with water is lifted in Koala's paws near her mouth at center.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα ἔχει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὸν σάκκον.
frames.text_english: The koala has the book and the bag.
objects: A simple brown-covered book with a cloth strap.
A tan linen sack with a simple drawstring.
positioning: Koala stands at center-left near an interior doorway, facing right.
A simple brown-covered book with a cloth strap is held in Koala's right paw close to her chest.
A tan linen sack with a simple drawstring hangs from Koala's left shoulder at her side.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα ἐξέρχεται διὰ τῆς θύρας.
frames.text_english: The koala goes out through the door.
objects: A sturdy wooden door with an iron latch and a sage-green frame.
positioning: Koala is mid-step through the doorway at center-right, moving from inside to outside.
A sturdy wooden door with an iron latch and a sage-green frame stands open on the right side of the scene.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα παίζει μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας.
frames.text_english: The koala plays with the ball.
objects: A small red leather ball with a single white stripe.
positioning: Koala crouches on the grass at center, facing right with paws ready.
A small red leather ball with a single white stripe rests on the grass just to Koala's right.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα βάλλει τὴν σφαῖραν πρὸς τὸν κύβον.
frames.text_english: The koala throws the ball toward the cube.
objects: A small red leather ball with a single white stripe.
A small blue wooden cube block with smooth edges.
positioning: Koala stands at left mid-throw, arms extended toward the right.
A small red leather ball with a single white stripe is in motion from Koala toward the right side.
A small blue wooden cube block with smooth edges sits on the grass at center-right as a target.

frames.text_koine: ἡ σφαῖρα πίπτει παρὰ τῷ λίθῳ.
frames.text_english: The ball falls beside the stone.
objects: A small red leather ball with a single white stripe.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw.
positioning: Koala stands at left watching the ball land near the stone.
A small red leather ball with a single white stripe comes to rest beside the stone at lower right.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw sits partly in the grass at lower right.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα ζητεῖ τὴν σφαῖραν παρὰ τῷ λίθῳ.
frames.text_english: The koala seeks the ball beside the stone.
objects: A small red leather ball with a single white stripe.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw.
positioning: Koala kneels at center-right and looks closely beside the stone.
A small red leather ball with a single white stripe is partly hidden in the grass against the far side of the stone.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw anchors the scene at center-right.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα εὑρίσκει τὴν σφαῖραν παρὰ τῷ λίθῳ, καὶ χαίρει.
frames.text_english: The koala finds the ball beside the stone, and is glad.
objects: A small red leather ball with a single white stripe.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw.
positioning: Koala stands at center lifting the ball with both paws and smiling.
A small red leather ball with a single white stripe is held above the grass next to Koala.
A round gray river stone about the size of Koala's paw sits on the ground at Koala's feet.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα εἰσέρχεται διὰ τῆς θύρας.
frames.text_english: The koala enters through the door.
objects: A sturdy wooden door with an iron latch and a sage-green frame.
positioning: Koala steps from outside into the doorway at center-left, facing inward.
A sturdy wooden door with an iron latch and a sage-green frame swings inward on the left.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα κρύπτει τὸ μῆλον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ.
frames.text_english: The koala hides the apple in the chest.
objects: A shiny red apple with a little green leaf.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp.
positioning: Koala kneels at center placing the apple into the open chest on the floor.
A shiny red apple with a little green leaf is set inside the chest at center.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp sits open on the floor at center-right.

objects: A shiny red apple with a little green leaf.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp.
positioning: Koala looks around at center-left, peeking near the chest.
A shiny red apple with a little green leaf sits inside the closed chest and is not visible from outside.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp is closed on the floor at center.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα εὑρίσκει τὸ μῆλον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ.
frames.text_english: The koala finds the apple in the chest.
objects: A shiny red apple with a little green leaf.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp.
positioning: Koala opens the chest at center and lifts the apple with her right paw.
A shiny red apple with a little green leaf is held just above the open chest at center.
A small brown wooden chest with a hinged lid and a bronze clasp stands open on the floor at center.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα βαίνει πρὸς τὴν κλίνην.
frames.text_english: The koala goes toward the bed.
positioning: Koala walks from the doorway at left toward the small bed at center-right.

frames.text_koine: ἡ κοάλα καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: The koala sleeps in the bed.
positioning: Koala curls under the green blanket on the bed at center-left with eyes closed.
